purpose: Slide-local ledger of continuity-preserving convex operations and the qualification each rule needs.

rows.operation: Restriction to a relatively open convex set inside dom f
rows.qualification: The set is measured in its own affine hull and f is convex there.
rows.continuity_output: f is continuous relative to that set, especially on ri(dom f).
rows.inspection: Every small segment through the point remains in the effective domain.

rows.qualification: The supremum is finite on the region being used.
rows.continuity_output: h is convex and hence continuous on any relatively open core of its finite domain.
rows.inspection: Upper envelope stays finite rather than escaping to plus infinity.

rows.qualification: Convexity of C and a finite-domain conclusion for h.
rows.continuity_output: Once h is finite on the open region, convexity forces continuity there.
rows.inspection: Infimal projection does not pinch the domain to a boundary-only set.

rows.qualification: The domains share a nonempty relative-interior point on the working affine hull.
rows.continuity_output: The sum is continuous on compact cores inside the common relative interior.
rows.inspection: There is a real buffer around the points where both summands are finite.

rows.qualification: The preimage of the relative-interior domain contains the working set.
rows.continuity_output: Continuity transfers along the affine map on the qualified region.
rows.inspection: The map does not send nearby points into a boundary blow-up path.

rows.qualification: Convex in x, pointwise continuity in t, and locally compact parameter neighborhoods.
rows.continuity_output: Equi-Lipschitz control in x upgrades separate information to joint continuity.
rows.inspection: A compact t-window supplies uniform bounds for the family.

rows.operation: Pointwise convergence of finite convex functions
rows.qualification: Convergence on a dense subset and pointwise boundedness on compact cores.
rows.continuity_output: The limit is finite convex and convergence is uniform on closed bounded subsets.
rows.inspection: A finite net plus a shared Lipschitz constant turns pointwise Cauchy data into uniform Cauchy data.
